DEC Alpha.fact: Another concept was a pure RISC system that would translate existing VAX code into its own ISA on-the-fly and store it in a CPU cache. Unfortunately, all of these approaches introduced overhead and would not be competitive with a pure-RISC machine running native RISC code.
